display_name: Six citations in the Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981, recorded as typed values with their tests: the bare citations of paragraphs (5) and (1) of section 18א in section 31א(א)(7) and (8) (two defects), the Ninth Schedule's short name for the Communications Law, which the Communications (Broadcasts) Law, 5786-2026, leaves in place while rewriting the Second and Third Schedules (one defect), and three sound controls; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the consumer to whom the Law is applied; for the Ninth Schedule, a consumer who makes a transaction for telephony, internet access or broadcasts with a provider. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.kind: excerpt of 19 lines of the raw wikitext of the Hebrew Wikisource page; `src:N` in the row's files is line N of the excerpt

excerpted_from.note: the whole page text is not deposited; SOURCES.json lists the whole-page line of each excerpt line

source.note: the excerpt is an unofficial consolidation; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ with their page images. Only the pages read are deposited: Sefer HaChukim 3572 as a three-page extract, and Sefer HaChukim 3569 as cropped page images with no PDF; SOURCES.json keeps the sha256 and size of each whole file as downloaded.

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of three defects, each stating what the citing words need. Section 31א(א)(7) and (8) cite paragraphs (5) and (1) of section 18א with no letter for the subsection, while Sefer HaChukim 2159 p. 576 (26.6.2008), section 1, marks the old text as subsection (א) and others follow; the bare numbers find two and at least three paragraphs. The Ninth Schedule, item 6 (Sefer HaChukim 3569 p. 907) uses the short name that item 1 of the Second Schedule defines, and section 105 of the Communications (Broadcasts) Law (Sefer HaChukim 3572 p. 1029) rewrites that definition and the Third Schedule's use and not the Ninth Schedule, on a day computed as 28 July 2028 from section 138(א). That the words are unchanged today rests on the consolidation (CONSOLIDATION-ONLY); the reading in context, under which the first two defects would pass, is recorded as a green test and as fork F1 in NOTES.md

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the nine official pages were read by the builder
